title: Watch The First Session of Day 5 of The Third Test between South Africa V Australia for Free @ Kayo Freebies
body:
Deal: Watch The First Session of Day 5 of The Third Test between South Africa V Australia for Free @ Kayo Freebies

[CBrads4] It’s good for those that don’t have another way of watching, but Kayo is such a garbage product, and only giving a session is so stingy.
Hopefully the whole session isn’t just buffering for those that tune in.
[Covid19] For someone who has been using Kayo, and not too happy with them, what are other alternatives please?
[QuickToThePointless] Wtf? Any cricket fan will have it already…and those who don’t, no one paying $46/30 to watch the 2 concluding sessions.
Kayo looking especially desperate post footy season this year…they have lost so many top tier rights lately and have little outside of midnight F1 coverage and a few irrelevant pyjama cricket games from Sep-Mar.
And FYI, you can get NBA/NBL for $10 pm vie ESPN on Disney…no need for Kayo until Aus v India Test Series next February!
And personally for AFL next year I am considering getting by solely on FTA coverage. I am in WA so get all Dockers /Eagles games+ Thur/Fri night footy free. It’s nice having all games but not paying more than $15 per month max.
[Daabido] Foxtel/Kayo has changed ownership. "You're living in the past, man! You're hung up on some clown from the '60s, man!"
[QuickToThePointless] @Daabido: Yes I know all about DAZN.. I dumbed it down for old mate binchicken as his top shelf best-gag was not very clever.
[King Steuart] I am a cricket fan, my $800/year goes to my MCC, not to Kayo
[djones145] i guess they think the aussies will collapse in under 30 overs….. :(
[CBrads4] Or we get some prime-time Travball to feast on.
[CBrads4] Ye of little faith in our Lord and saviour, Trav.
[QuickToThePointless] @CBrads4: I hope Trav and Marnus win it for us
[Signet] @QuickToThePointless: If Marnus were to get a double century now is the time!
[QuickToThePointless] @Signet: Last chance for marnus but probably already out regardless…will miss his incessant high energy nonsense in the slips but probably means Inglis gets a run for India and the Ashes…I’m a perth lad so would be cool to see Connolly Inglis and green in the team for the next 5 years or so!
[djones145] @QuickToThePointless: 6 now… we might make it to lunch!
[QuickToThePointless] @djones145: been watching whole series.
both teams had great sessions, medicore ones; individaul brilliance and brain explosions.
was all set for a tight final day to decide the series…then this.
aussies better sort out the batting line up before NZ rock up in a month… the chopping and changing since Warner reitred is just unprofessional from George Bailey and co; no one know what theyre doing from 1-6 apart from Steve Smith…7 in a session WTF?
well done Proteas.
[kron] Ha ha….You can offer whatever free product you want Kayo, you ain't getting my subscription. Hot garbage!
[joshptyltd] This is like saying you can have 1 chip from the chip packet that is going to expire today.
Thanks Kayo?
[QuickToThePointless] Or like 1/2 of the last 1/4 of the afl/nrl grand final
Bargain?!?
[Whatisthatvelvet] Just make the whole last day available ya scumbags
[Arturo88] Day 4 still missing the full replay, tech support offered me a 5% refund for the inconvenience, service has been terrible for this series. Over it.
[QuickToThePointless] If you keep hammering threaten to quit and ask for retention specialist they will
Offer 25% off next month minimum, a free month max.
[Arturo88] Ended up with a 25% refund after a solid 10 minutes. Sigh.

Where should i be looking
